title: A minimax Bilinear Transport Problem and Nash-Monge-Kantorovich Maps
summary: We study a min-max bilinear transport problem arising from a two-player zero-sum game with quadratic kinetic and interaction costs. Starting from a dynamic path space formulation, we establish existence of minimax and maximin plans and prove a minimax theorem. We show that the equilibrium induces a finite-dimensional stationary problem via an endpoint cost on transport plans, which is well defined below a critical interaction strength and yields a Nash equilibrium over couplings.
